name: Indian Classical Music: History, Appreciation, and Therapeutics
description: Introduction to indian classical music. Historical perspectives through some classical texts such as natya sastra, dattila, brihaddesi, and sangeeta ratnakara. Introduction to the aesthetic elements of classical music. The elements of a composition including the raag (melody), taal (rhythm), and lyrics. Creativity and spontaneity in music. The differences between south and north Indian forms of music. Comparison between different lighter forms of music such as folk, regional, and popular music with classical music will also form part of the course. Introduction to music therapy. Goals of music therapy. Designing evidence-based music interventions for therapeutic applications such as melodic intonation therapy. Case studies on music therapy with focus on acquired brain injury, addiction treatment, pain management, memory disorders and speech disorders.
